String: <he/she>'s warning you to get off her turf before things get ugly.
<he/she>'s eyeing you as <he/she> drinks from <random-person-indefinite>.
<he/she>'s twitching like one of those mascot horror game characters.
<he/she> doesn't seem intimidated by you in the slightest. If anything, <he/she> looks irked that you're staring at <him/her>.
<he/she> starts circling you like a hawk while licking a <red lollipop/suspicious looking popsicle/a severed human finger/giant mosquito's blood sack>.
<he/she>'s sitting on a <woman/man> who is acting as <his/her> chair, with another who is <his/her> footstool.
<he/she>'s dipping <his/her> fingers repeatedly into a recently deceased victim's bitemarks.
<he/she>'s wearing old victorian clothing and chatting with someone in a posh accent.
<he/she>'s stabbing random people with a pour spout, releasing their blood into a goblet, and sipping as if <he/she>'s at a fine wine tasting event.
<he/she> looking right through you, as though you <were invisible/didn't exist>.
<he/she>'s filing <his/her> fangs with a menacing smile.
<he/she> sees you, then quickly sinks <his/her> fangs into a passerby's neck, making it rain blood on both of you.
<he/she>'s in the process of burying a body so drained it looks like a raisin.
<he/she> has a <rat/raccoon/squirrel/bird> in <his/her> mouth and shaking it vigorously side-to-side, spraying blood everywhere.
<he/she>'s singing <DK Gavan's Rocky Road to Dublin/Solomon Linda's The Lion Sleeps Tonight/John Lennon's Imagine> a cappella with two other vampires, enticing humans to sing along with them.
<he/she> appears to be on a business call, with a familiar holding <his/her> laptop at eye level.
<his/her> pack of <pit bulls terriers/rottweilers> are staring you down while growling.
<he/she> engages you on a philosophical level regarding the ethics of blood drinking, and whether doing so with humans is cannibalism.
<he/she> is posing dramatically in the sun, weeping over the fact that <his/her> glittery skin is that of a killer's.
<he/she>'s letting out a breathy "wrrryyyyy" while posing with a menacing aura.
<he/she>'s squeezing coagulated blood from a bottle and rubbing it on <his/her> skin like sunscreen.
<he/she>'s sitting in the back of a bloodmobile, slurping from a tube attached to a giant tank.
While twiddling <his/her> thumbs, <he/she> asks if you "wanna be hunting fwends".
<he/she>'s smoking a blunt wrapped in human skin.
<he/she> unbuttoned <his/her> shirt, exposing the scars of failed assassination attempts on <his/her> chest with pride.
<he/she>'s spreading vampire awareness by giving out free copies of Anne Rice's "Interview with The Vampire".
